Singapore Tops Air Pollution Rankings Amid Regional Haze

Singapore has again been ranked as the world's most polluted city, according to Swiss-based air quality monitor IQAir. The deterioration in air quality is attributed to toxic haze emitted from fires on Borneo and Sumatra islands, intensified by an El Nino weather phenomenon. In response, the city-state has opened some community spaces to residents and rolled out haze subsidies.
